note: Read-only Windows process samples. UTC timestamps retained. Private bytes are not JS heap sizes and samples do not prove a memory leak or causation.

notes: Read-only process metadata only. No UI/browser/SDK/network/customer or storage operations; command lines were inspected only transiently for whitelisted process type and boolean profile classification, never saved or printed.
Sample timestamps are collection completion UTC; process collection is sequential, not an atomic JS-heap measurement. No inference of leak or long-term stability from two samples.
Default-profile renderer classification does not identify the exact local window. Isolated profile classification does not identify busy/idle account.

sound_log_static_evidence.assessment: Production soundLog array grows once per validated notify://play-sound event. No length cap, ring-buffer eviction or reset path was found in static references. It stores enum names; this is not evidence that it caused previous GB-level private memory. No fix made.
